source_name: King County Assessor — Assessments Data Download (RPSALE_EXTR, PARCEL_EXTR, RPACCT_EXTR, RESBLDG_EXTR)
verification_note: URL appeared in search results 2026-08-25 ('King County Department of Assessments: Assessments Data Download'); extract-table docs seen at www5.kingcounty.gov/sdc FGDC pages.
update_frequency: weekly (GIS-side copies of sales extract stated weekly)
terms_notes: Assessor site is the authoritative source; GIS Data Catalog copies are value-added derivatives the Assessor does not consider authoritative.
difficulty_reason: Official bulk downloads with documented layouts; dedicated sales file keyed by excise tax number + major/minor.
notes: RPSALE_EXTR is a dedicated real-property SALES file — the best free comps feed among covered western metros. 100% of true and fair market value per RCW 84.40.030; annual revaluation, 6-year physical inspection cycle.

source_name: eReal Property search + Localscape tax-transparency dashboard
verification_note: eReal Property catalog entry URL and https://localscape.property/ ('King County WA - Analytics') both appeared in search results 2026-08-25.
terms_notes: Per-parcel lookup; no bulk export from these UIs (use Data Download instead).
difficulty_reason: Official lookup tools; Parcel Viewer links each parcel to eReal report and development-conditions report.
notes: Localscape (Assessor) layers sales patterns, tax transparency, permits, census over parcels.

source_name: Recorder's Office online records search (Landmark)
verification_note: URL appeared in search results 2026-08-25.
cost: free index/images online; recording fee $303.50 first page + $1/page
terms_notes: Index 1976-present; images for most documents Aug 1 1991-present; pre-1991 microfilm at King County Archives. No bulk index download surfaced.
difficulty_reason: Free search but UI-only; multiple searches by name/parcel/STR recommended; no bulk export.
notes: WA REET graduated statewide (1.10%/1.28%/2.75%/3.00% marginal brackets at $525k/$1.525M/$3.025M, seller pays) + 0.50% King County local REET; excise tax numbers from REET affidavits key the Assessor sales extract.

source_name: Treasury property tax foreclosures + annual September auction
verification_note: URL and subpages (/auctions, /auctions/properties, /tax-title-properties) appeared in search results 2026-08-25. Auction platform quoted in snippet text as king.wa.realforeclose.com but that URL did not itself appear as a result link — treat platform URL as unverified.
terms_notes: Parcels sold where-is/as-is, no title guarantee; unsold parcels become tax title, resold via Bid4Assets.
difficulty_reason: Annual cadence and PDF/HTML lists; auction requires RealAuction registration.
notes: Tax foreclosure begins at 3 full years delinquent. Nonjudicial trustee (mortgage) sales are separate: notice of trustee's sale recorded >=90 days pre-sale per RCW 61.24.040 (app.leg.wa.gov) — find them in the recorder index; no county aggregation page surfaced.

source_name: King County Superior Court — unlawful detainers; WA Odyssey Portal / JIS-Link (statewide)
verification_note: County UD page URL appeared 2026-08-25. Odyssey Portal / JIS-Link were described in results but no direct court-portal URL surfaced — those specific endpoints remain unverified (searched 'Washington state courts eviction unlawful detainer records online search odyssey').
cost: Odyssey basic case info free; JIS-Link is a paid subscription for statewide dockets
terms_notes: Eviction (UD) cases are Superior Court civil cases; third-party aggregators claim ~7-year coverage of 33/39 counties — unofficial.
difficulty_reason: No bulk public feed; per-case portal lookups or paid JIS-Link subscription.
notes: Rent-cap rule text (2025 HB 1217: lesser of 7%+CPI or 10%; 9.683% for 2026) lives in data/research/regulatory_rules.json.
